topic: Equivalent Capacitance of a Cube Network
problem: Each edge of a cube contains a capacitor of capacitance C. Find the equivalent capacitance of the network when it is connected to an external circuit through conductors attached to the opposite vertices A and B of the cube.
diagram_caption: The cube has eight vertices labeled A, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Each of the twelve edges contains one capacitor of capacitance C. The edge connections are A-1, A-2, A-3, 1-4, 1-6, 2-5, 2-6, 3-4, 3-5, 4-B, 5-B, 6-B. Conductors extend outward from A and B, the two external connection points.
solution: Symmetry about the diagonal AB makes vertices 1,2,3 equipotential, and vertices 4,5,6 equipotential. The layers contain 3, 6, 3 parallel capacitors, equivalent to 3C, 6C, 3C in series. Therefore 1/C0 = 1/(3C) + 1/(6C) + 1/(3C) = 5/(6C), so C0 = (6/5)C.
